name: duckdb-gdrive
description: Skills for the gdrive DuckDB extension: Google Drive in SQL -- secrets and sign-in (gcloud ADC, service accounts, workload identity, OAuth), the gdrive:// filesystem (paths, id:, globs, browser addresses, COPY, DuckLake, native Sheets and Docs), Sheets by tab and range (read_sheet_range, COPY ... FORMAT sheet_range), and Drive's metadata as tables (files with owners and links, search, versions, change feeds, permissions).
